title: Is the AI bubble about to pop?
description: Test script for the real-photo visuals (photo, photos, headlines, quote).

scenes.say: Every big tech company is spending billions on giant buildings full of chips.

visual.show: rows of servers in a data center
visual.caption: Billions on *chips*

scenes.say: And most of those chips come from one company: Nvidia, led by Jensen Huang.

items.show: an Nvidia H100 GPU chip or card
items.label: Nvidia's *chip*

scenes.say: We've seen this movie before. In March 2000 the Nasdaq hit its peak. By October 2002 it had lost almost eighty percent.
Back in 1996, Alan Greenspan asked the question everyone is asking again today.

visual.text: But how do we know when *irrational exuberance* has unduly escalated asset values

scenes.say: So is this a bubble, or the real thing? Tell me in the comments. Thoma out!
